create_TensorBoardLogger: create a TensorBoardLogger instance that wraps SummaryWriter with distributed training support
log_dict_scalars: log multiple scalar values to TensorBoard from a dictionary mapping tag names to scalar values
log_scalar_data: log a single scalar value to TensorBoard with a tag name and step number
log_visuals_images: log image or video tensors to TensorBoard with automatic dimension detection
close_TensorBoardLogger: close the TensorBoardLogger writer and flush pending logs to disk
